messages:
julia: Hey team — customer on prod upgraded our internal app and pulled in redwood-python 1.30.0. Now seeing repeated retries for a single user request, double billing, and occasional 401s from the auth service. Happening ~5% of requests since deploy.
julia: Minimal repro: we call client.generate(...). Sometimes we see two POSTs to /v1/generate within 200ms, and one of them fails with 401. Billing shows two tokens billed. Logs:
```
[INFO] request_id=abc123 attempt=1 POST /v1/generate 200
[INFO] request_id=abc123 attempt=2 POST /v1/generate 401 Authorization failed
```
julia: We do not set idempotency keys. Using default retry behavior from SDK. Pinned transient retry config looks unchanged.
chris: Ouch. Which exact SDK version and runtime? Any other HTTP client libs (urllib3/requests) pinned?
julia: pip freeze excerpt:
```
redwood-sdk==1.30.0
requests==2.31.0
urllib3==2.0.3
```
julia: App env: GKE, nginx ingress, no special proxy. We only see the doubled POSTs to Redwood endpoint (same request_id in our logs but two separate server-side request_ids returned).
sam_eng: tagging in. @lina_support can you escalate if it's a customer-facing outage? Also julia — can you capture a HAR or tcpdump? Want to know if client is re-sending or gateway is replaying.
lina_support: I'm on it, notifying account team and offering to roll back customer to previous release while we triage. Can you try a quick local repro and set SDK env var REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES=0 and re-run?
julia: Tried locally with REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES=0 — single POST now, no double billing on same payload. With default retries it replays twice.
chris: That strongly implies SDK retry logic is re-sending non-idempotent requests. Did 1.30 change default idempotency or header names? I remember a param rename in a recent release.
sam_eng: Checking changelog — 1.30 introduced transient retry middleware and renamed timeout_ms -> timeout_ms (no, that seems unchanged). But there was a subtle change: when `idempotency_key` is omitted, SDK used to attach an auto-generated header `Idempotency-Key`. Looks like the auto-key generation was removed in 1.30 if a custom transport is present.
chris: So if the SDK isn't sending an idempotency header, retries become unsafe for POST generate. Workaround: set client param `idempotency_key="<uuid>"` or pin to 1.29.x.
julia: Customer needs immediate mitigation. Which pin is safest?
sam_eng: Recommend pin to 1.29.4 (last patched 1.29) while we push hotfix. Also as a short-term workaround set env REDWOOD_SDK_RETRIES=0 or ensure you pass idempotency_key per request.
lina_support: I'll propose the rollback to customer and share both workarounds. Also collecting request_ids to reconcile billing.
julia: Tracked. I'll pin 1.29.4 and retest on prod canary, then share logs. Thanks.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: rollback-candidate -> canary at 2:14pm UTC (manual approval required).
